experience.roleTitle: Software Developer Intern in IT Department
experience.description:
- Selected for an onsite Software Internship.
- Assisting with internal IT operations and software development tasks under the supervision of Mr. Sumit Shrotriya.

- Developed a full-stack job portal using .NET Core (MVC) and SQL Server.
- Implemented job filtering based on title, salary, and location.
- Designed responsive UI for improved user experience.

projects.title: SimplyNotes
projects.description: Engineered a hierarchical data structure for Workspaces, Folders, and Notes using JPA/Hibernate. Features a high-fidelity 'Glassmorphism' UI with Framer Motion, secure JWT authentication, UUID mapped file uploads, and public-sharing logic for generating read-only note links.
projects.tags: React.js, Spring Boot, Java, MySQL, Spring Security, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion

projects.title: Supervisor Feedback Analyzer
projects.description: Developed a full-stack AI-powered system integrating Llama 3.2 to analyze unstructured feedback. Features prompt engineering, JSON extraction, and a structured dashboard displaying scoring, KPI mapping, evidence tagging, gap analysis, and follow-up questions.
projects.tags: React.js, Spring Boot, Ollama (Llama 3.2), REST APIs

projects.title: SimplyMusic
projects.description: A full-stack audio microservices ecosystem featuring JWT authentication via Keycloak, S3-compatible media storage with MinIO, NoSQL indexing using MongoDB, and a sleek React frontend.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Built using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, featuring smooth scrolling, complex scroll-linked fluid animations, and premium dark-mode UI aesthetics.
